characters.description: Abhorrent Admirer: It's implied Jenny Quackles wants nothing to do with him since she dumped coffee on his head in one episode when he called her "too cute". Ax-Crazy: He becomes this briefly in "Food Fight Club" laughing insanely and using a chainsaw made of grain. Dirty Old Man: His elderly self in the far future still is in love with Jenny's current self. Distracted by the Sexy: Inverted.SwaySwayis in love with Jenny Quackles who eats disgusting food and throws up. Drives Like Crazy: Has no regard for staying in a straight line when driving the Rocket Van, usually parking it by crashing it into things.

characters.name: SwaySway
characters.description: Abhorrent Admirer: It's implied Jenny Quackles wants nothing to do with him since she dumped coffee on his head in one episode when he called her "too cute". Ax-Crazy: He becomes this briefly in "Food Fight Club" laughing insanely and using a chainsaw made of grain. Berserk Button: Don't mess with his hat (as seen in "Food Fight Club"), or erase his high score on hisDucky Kongmachine (as seen in "Kettastrophe"). Beware the Nice Ones:SwaySwayis a nice and happy guy, but if anyone hurts Buhdeuce they will pay. Catchphrase:Owcheewawa!My ducky-duck(s).Party Punch!YO-reka! (Eureka)

characters.name: Buhdeuce
characters.description: The Ace: In a sense. Many episode conflicts come fromSwaySwayfailing to qualify for something that Buhdeuce is anInstant Expertat. Ass Kicks You: Invoked with Buhdeuce's "Booty Kick". Acro Fatic: Buhdeuce is great at cartwheels, somersaults, ninja rolls, and flips, in spite of his extreme chubbiness. Big Eater: Buhdeuce keeps eating bread;and that is only the normal stuff he's eaten. Catchphrase:Bubble nuggets!Oh my bap!YEAH BOY!Booty Kick!Ninja roll, cartwheel, somersault, flip!No-buh-dooby-doo.Yippity-yip-yip!

characters.name: Ketta
characters.description: Action Girl: She uses her mechanical skills to save the day. Big Sister Instinct: She acts like a big sister toSwaySwayand Buhdeuce, she is always there to save them when a situation needs her smarts and she hugs them when they are okay. She also keeps them in line in "Viking Ducks" and "Don't Feed the Duckosaurs". Catchphrase:Aw, lug nuts!Honk!Whoa-mi-gosh! Expy: She is very similar to Gadget Hackwrench fromChip N Dale Rescue Rangers; both characters arebubblyWrench Wencheswith reddish hair who sport headgear of some sort (Ketta's helmet and Gadget's goggles). Genki Girl: She is very bubbly and energetic.

characters.name: T-Midi
characters.description: Abusive Parents: It implies he is or was abused by his mother in "Bros Night Out". Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: T-Midi is a jerk who acts like he hatesSwaySwayand Buhdeuce, but in "TNT-Midi", he cares about them. In "Bro's Night Out", "A Crustmas Story", "Birthday Bread" and "Slumber Party of Horror", he is shown to actually like hanging around them. Catchphrase:Sheesh-a-roo-roo!Abso-hoot-ly! (most of the time followed by "not!") Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He is mean and snooty towards others, especially the Breadwinners, considering their friendship effectively on-again off-again, but he's not without his nice moments and he does appreciate the Breadwinners and their bread. Mama's Boy: Absolutely adores his mother.

characters.name: Jenny Quackles
characters.description: All Girls Want Bad Boys: Jenny loves men who are cruel, such as a criminal biker, a scooter rider who is a show off jerk, and the Loafrechaun who torturedSwaySwayand Buhdeuce. In "Bad to the Duck Bone" she falls in love withSnakeSnake,SwaySway'sevil alter ego. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: In "Quack to the Future" it's revealed Jenny threw up onSwaySwaybecause she actually likes him and the two go on a date. Expy: Seems to be one of Daisy Duck, being a white duck with a bow on her head. Hot Guy, Ugly Wife:SwaySwayis slender, has a cute face when he shows emotion, and dresses in cool clothes, while Jenny is very realistic looking, drools, vomits, and eats gross food. Loves My Alter Ego: A villainous example. Jenny beats upSwaySwaywhen he flirts with her but she loves his evil alter egoSnakeSnake.

characters.name: Jelly
characters.description: Action Girl: She applies to this in "PB & J", she (like her owners) levels up into an "action hero frog" and easily fights off a group of panda-like bears. All Animals Are Dogs: She is a pet frog who acts just like a dog. Badass Adorable: As seen in "PB&J" Damsel in Distress: In "Brocastination", "Tunnel of Fear" and "The Princess Frog Bride" One-Word Vocabulary: She can only ever say "Ribbit!"

characters.name: Chief Rambamboo
characters.description: Action Girl: She is such a tough cop, even a monster is afraid of her. Blush Sticker: She has pink little ovals on her face. Catchphrase: "Leapin' lilypads!" Fiery Redhead: She has brownish red hair and is an extremely quick-tempered, aggressiveAction Girlcop. Furry Reminder: She not only enjoys eating flies but she uses her tongue like a real toad would.

characters.name: Oonski the Great
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: He terrorizes the residents of Pondgea by attacking them. Catchphrase:Eat! Beat! Steal!Viking's honor! Even Evil Has Standards: Oonski sings a Christmas carol about all the things he steals, but he refuses to steal six crying babies. Testosterone Poisoning: A Viking beaver withNO INDOOR VOICEor etiquette, whose catchphrase is"EAT! BEAT! STEAL!". Wouldn't Hurt a Child: Oonski is ruthless, steals from others, and beats them up. But in "A Crustmas Story" he refuses to kidnap six crying babies.

characters.name: The Bread Maker
characters.description: Gratuitous Spanish: He says Spanish words or puns based on Spanish words. The Mentor: He serves this to the duo. Never Bareheaded: He is never seen without his sunglasses. Not So Stoic: The Breadmaker, who's usually cool and collected, breaks down when trying to cure the zombie outbreak in "Night of the Living Bread". Apparently, he's not great under pressure.
